FIX ROUND 1 (OPENING) (TRAIN-GATE-128, agent 129) — growth-project-mobile#521 @ 0b10156da508c37cba55a18f902ad97ab6cb953e — READY FOR AUDIT

Posted by operator agent 129 for the stopped builder TRAIN-GATE-128, whose report HANDOFF says to post READY once CI is green at this head. CI: 4 of 4 checks SUCCESS at 0b10156d. 602 changed lines, 12 files. T4 (entitlement gate on a paid client's live workout): both lenses at this exact head.

What changes for clients: leaving the app or the screen mid-workout keeps the workout where it was; Resume is the first choice; deleting a workout in progress is its own confirmed action (Discard workout); a paid client on weak signal is no longer dropped to Choose a Plan mid-workout (only a confirmed inactive result gates). Details, parity table and tests are in the PR body. Owner decision 1 (keep the autosave defaults as built) is still open; recommended default: keep.

AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol (LN-SOL-D3-129) — growth-project-mobile#521 @ 0b10156da508c37cba55a18f902ad97ab6cb953e — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES

Independent T4 review; agent 129.

**B-521-SOL-1 — unfinished draft deleted on ordinary Leave/Back.** A client writes workout notes or edits sets before ticking the first completed set, taps Leave/Back, and loses the autosaved draft because the new zero-completed-sets branch deletes it without confirmation. [ActiveWorkoutScreen.tsx:1088–1137](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/0b10156da508c37cba55a18f902ad97ab6cb953e/src/screens/client/ActiveWorkoutScreen.tsx#L1088-L1137)

Proof: autosave retains every exercise/set and workout note, not only completed sets; `logged === 0` nonetheless calls `releaseEmptySession`, which stops persistence, drops the pending payload and clears storage. [Autosave:418–449](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/0b10156da508c37cba55a18f902ad97ab6cb953e/src/screens/client/ActiveWorkoutScreen.tsx#L418-L449) [Notes field:1269](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/0b10156da508c37cba55a18f902ad97ab6cb953e/src/screens/client/ActiveWorkoutScreen.tsx#L1269)

Smallest fix: preserve/flush the unfinished draft on ordinary leave/back; do not treat zero completed sets as no saved work or clear it before successful Finish. Add a failing-first mounted regression: edit notes/reps/weight with zero completed sets, Leave and Back, then reopen and assert those exact edits survive.

The confirmed-active recheck exception, first-fetch fail-closed branch and inactive/402 reset otherwise follow the intended boundary. [Entitlement provider](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/0b10156da508c37cba55a18f902ad97ab6cb953e/src/entitlements/EntitlementProvider.tsx#L89-L165)

602 changed lines; exact-head required CI and CodeQL green; no production access or local full suite. [Required CI](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37696307775/job/113048787054)
